correctness.rationale: For Σ⊂Z₃ with digits 0,1, x∈Σ and 31x∈Σ iff each carry c and digit b∈{0,1} has (31b+c) mod3∈{0,1}, next c′=floor((31b+c)/3). Starting c=0 gives exactly ten reachable carries 0,1,3,4,5,10,11,12,14,15; each can reach the zero carry loop and so every counted prefix is indefinitely extendible. The explicit ten-state adjacency A satisfies the exact integer coordinate identity (A⁵−A⁴−A−I)1=0; propagation by A^k establishes a_n=a_(n−1)+a_(n−4)+a_(n−5) for all n≥5, first terms 1,2,3,5,7 and rational generating function (1+z)(1+z²+z³)/(1−z−z⁴−z⁵). Positive primitive growth gives beta>1 unique root t⁵−t⁴−t−1=0 and the Abram–Lagarias p-adic path-set dimension log₃(beta). Independently rebuilt all ten carry states/edge count and checked the exact all-state vector identity; separately enumerated admissible modulo-3^n prefixes for n≤10. The finite vector identity itself, not numerical extrapolation, certifies all lengths.
